answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 145491 Country: South Africa Title: After slaughtering the animal some blood is found stuck on the neck of the animal. Is it wajib to wash of the blood before eating the meat of the neck or can it be cooked and eaten as it is. Question: After slaughtering the animal some blood is found stuck on the neck of the animal. Is it wajib to wash of the blood before eating the meat of the neck or can it be cooked and eaten as it is. Answer ID: 145491 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 120/67/B=2/1438) Yes, it is necessary to wash the meat of the neck before eating it. It is lawful to cook and eat it. (Bahishti Zewar vol. 9, p. 106) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
